name: review-ml-paper
description: Generate concise English and Chinese ML/CS paper reviews plus a four-part Chinese paper interpretation.

interface.shortDescription: Generate concise English and Chinese paper reviews plus a four-part Chinese interpretation.
interface.longDescription: A portable Agent Skill that drafts a conference-style English review, a four-part Chinese paper interpretation, and a matching Chinese review from a supplied manuscript, PDF, or notes.
defaultPrompt: Write a conference-style English review, a four-part Chinese interpretation, and a matching Chinese review.
